title: LISTSCRIPTS JSON built with Rust Debug fmt — breaks on control-char script names
description: sieve_admin.rs list_scripts handler: format\!(r#"{\"name\":{:?},\"active\":{}}", name, active). Using {:.?} on a String relies on Rust's Debug impl producing valid JSON. It works for most ASCII printable characters. Fails for control characters U+0001..U+001F (excluding \t, \n, \r): Debug outputs \u{1} but JSON requires \u0001. valid_script_name() only excludes '/', '\0', and '..'; control chars pass validation. Rewrite: use a proper JSON library (serde_json, which is already a transitive dep via axum). Suggested fix: derive Serialize on a response struct and use axum::Json as the return type.
